title: You all are my favorite
content: I Look at a lot of random reddit pages-mostly to go down a rabbit hole or compare different opinions. I'm studying so many different religions and practices to piece it all together. And I just gotta say-this group is my favorite. There's rarely meanness. It's all wonder and what ifs? It's really the most beautiful group. Even on Reddit, it shows lol. I think finding childlike wonder like this on earth is the 🗝️. What will it unlock? I have no gd idea! *Continues to furiously read occult books*
